svg.title: Engineering Journey Timeline
svg.desc: Timeline from 2022 to 2026: 2022 — Started coding; 2023 — Discovered Machine Learning; 2024 — Discovered AI; 2024 — Young AI — Winner; 2025 — Auraverse Hackathon — Winner; 2025 — Cardano Hackathon, Asia — Finalist; 2026 — Mela VC Ventures — 2nd Place; 2026 — Co-founded Kovidam; 2026 — Product & Applied AI Lead — AI-ML Club; SEP 2026 — Gradient Rush Hackathon — Winner. Milestones are self-reported career markers, not derived from repository activity.
